problem: B4 draft blindness removed harmful answer anchoring but discarded potentially useful partial hypotheses, while the exhaustive B5 replay proved that its three generated bridges contained no hidden gold-retrieving candidate. The immediate gap is generating answer-linked anchors without treating a prior subject guess as fact.
simplest_baseline: B4 is one draft-blind generation call followed by one self-selected search; B5 showed that searching all three B4 candidates still yields zero gold hits.
hypothesis: A Hypothesis Firewall that exposes only the original question, deterministic obligation, and one explicitly unverified prior subject seed, while requiring one seed expansion plus two seed-independent counter-hypotheses and searching all three, will retrieve gold on at least two of three saved failures.
changed_mechanisms: typed hypothesis firewall with one unverified seed and two mandatory counter-hypotheses
anti_claim: This is frozen-model context governance and retrieval routing. It is not training and must not be described as improving the underlying model's capability.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: The firewall borrows isolation and structured return, but adds an epistemic type boundary: the retained subject is explicitly unverified, exact answers are blocked, and two counter-hypotheses are mandatory rather than optional delegation.
The legacy multi-agent warning keeps role count out of the hypothesis. This loop changes only information exposure and counter-hypothesis structure inside one generation call.

GPT Researcher expands research questions into execution agents. The firewall uses one model call and exactly three fixed local searches only after answer-level evidence debt, so its cost and causal variable remain narrower.

The three-query slate is a bounded debt-triggered frontier, not a general search graph. It must first pass saved failures and later a matched-budget unseen comparison before graph expansion is considered.

frozen_controls: same three outcome-selected open-debt development cases
prior exact answer, full draft, prior query, and gold IDs excluded from prompt
one unverified subject seed extracted from the frozen audit
one provider attempt and exactly three top-20 searches per case
same query-aware BM25-anchor plus Dense-lead retriever
no Writer or Judge during retrieval calibration
multi_agent_comparison_contract: B2 = current single-context Evidence Debt; B3 = fixed three parallel Researchers and remains unimplemented; B4 = rejected draft-blind single packet; B6 = one Hypothesis Firewall call returning a three-query slate. Lock model, retriever, corpus, total provider calls, search calls, Token and USD accounting before any unseen comparison.
next_action: Do not integrate the firewall slate. Run a separately labeled, matched-input bridge-generation capability diagnostic with deepseek-v4-pro before spending more effort on prompt-only Flash mechanisms; any model change must remain separate from harness-effect claims.
claim_boundary: A calibration pass would support only the typed firewall mechanism on three known failures. It would not establish end-to-end effectiveness, unseen generalization, official accuracy, leaderboard rank, or model-capability improvement.
